item.title: What we know so far about Sweden’s newest suspected spy scandal
item.description: A man in his 30s was arrested in Stockholm on Sunday on suspicion of espionage. Here’s what we know about the case so far.

item.title: Today in Sweden: A roundup of the latest news on Thursday
item.description: Buses in Gothenburg cancelled as snowfall continues, 17-year old jailed for shooting, inflation falls faster than expected, and other news from Sweden on Thursday.

item.title: In pictures: readers capture Sweden's New Year snowscapes
item.description: Rajesh Babu wins this month's reader photo for his action photo of children skating in a snowstorm. Read the story to see who made the list of runners up.

item.title: How to dress your child for the cold, wet Swedish winter
item.description: You'll find children in Sweden play outside in winter come rain, snow or sleet. Here's how to kit your child out the Swedish way.

item.title: Red warning and emergency alerts as snow hits northern Sweden
item.description: An emergency VMA warning and a red alert have been issued for parts of Norrland as the snow and wind continues to batter Sweden.

item.title: TELL US: Are you considering moving away from Sweden?
item.description: If you're considering moving away from Sweden, whether that's back home or to another country, or have already done so, we want to know why. Let us know in this survey.

item.title: Swedish word of the day: jättekallt
item.description: With snow and cold temperatures across Sweden today, what better day to choose "really cold" as our word of the day?

item.title: EXPLAINED: How to take long-term leave from work in Sweden
item.description: Most people have probably felt at some point that they'd benefit from a long-term break from their work, and in Sweden there are several ways you can do that, safe in the knowledge that your job will be waiting for you when you return.

item.title: What's happening with the American takeover of Sweden's Northvolt?
item.description: In March 2025 Swedish electric battery manufacturer Northvolt became the largest bankruptcy case in modern Swedish history. An American company has now bought Northvolt's assets and is starting to rehire in Sweden – but is the sale even finalized?

item.title: 'I thought if I worked really, really hard, I'd have a chance of staying in Sweden'
item.description: Fereshteh Javani, a campaigner against the abolition of Sweden's track-change law, has told The Local of the year of extra long hours she went through in a battle to meet the work permit salary threshold, only to then have her right to a work permit stripped away from her anyway.
